dedupe_keys.name: coupling differentiable modules of reservoir operation and rainfall runoff processes for streamflow simulation

description: Zexin Chen and Tongtiegang Zhao at Sun Yat-sen University publish code coupling a differentiable HBV rainfall-runoff model with the reservoir-operation module from CWatM. Differentiable parameter learning connects the modules to simulate streamflow in human-regulated catchments. The October 2025 Zenodo deposit provides dPLHBV_ROM.rar free under CC BY 4.0 and credits the upstream HBV implementation archived as Zenodo 7943626. The description identifies model lineage but leaves programming language, environment versions, catchment coverage, temporal resolution and training periods unknown. A modeller could use the coupled implementation to compare reservoir regulation and runoff response within one learned simulation system. The upstream HBV papers describe its foundations and are not evidence that this particular coupling has reproduced their accuracy. Related catalogue record model-iiasa-cwatm-community-water-model covers the parent model, not this separately published coupling. The archive was not downloaded or executed.
